# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in the Biotime app, please report it by emailing the maintainers or opening a private issue. Do **not** disclose security issues publicly until they have been reviewed and patched.

- Email: security@yourdomain.com
- Please include as much detail as possible to help us reproduce and address the issue.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version of Biotime is actively supported with security updates.

## Responsible Disclosure

We appreciate responsible disclosure and will make every effort to address valid security issues promptly.
